Name: Recolour Mask for Daisyniko's Tilesheet
Author: Lavliette
Description:
There are many great recolours, but not all of them support Daisyniko's Tilesheets, which is used by many beautiful farm maps. 
So I decided to share my DNT Recolour Mask with you, so you can add unsupported Recolours to DNT or make some fixes to existing Recolours yourself. 

The Masks are very colourful so you can exactly see what goes where. It includes cliff, dirt, grass, water and snow.
It covers the latest up to date version of DNT.
